import subprocess, pathlib, json, re
P=pathlib.Path('/Users/huangrende/Desktop/应聘/chatgpt-share-6ab13ad3/opl_v226_execution_spec'); C='opl-spec-db-alignment-20260922'; results=[]
def run(db,sql,expect=None,label=''):
 p=subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-i',C,'psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-v','VERBOSITY=verbose','-U','postgres','-d',db,'-At'],input=sql,capture_output=True,text=True)
 ok=(p.returncode==0) if not expect else (p.returncode!=0 and re.search(r'ERROR:\s+'+expect+r':',p.stderr) is not None)
 results.append(dict(label=label,database=db,expectedSQLSTATE=expect or '00000',passed=ok))
 if not ok: raise RuntimeError(label+'\n'+p.stdout+'\n'+p.stderr)
 return p.stdout
D='sha256:'+'a'*64
cap="INSERT INTO capability.capability_versions(id,version_label,artifact_repository,artifact_digest,model_requirements,data_compatibility,provenance_evidence,provenance,legacy_application_revision_id) VALUES ('legacy-revision-A','legacy-v1','sandbox/repo','"+D+"','[]','{}','{}','legacy_application','existing-string-revision');"
run('opl_capability',cap,label='opaque legacy ID + valid imported provenance')
run('opl_capability',"INSERT INTO capability.capability_versions(id,version_label,artifact_repository,artifact_digest,model_requirements,data_compatibility,provenance_evidence,provenance,legacy_application_revision_id,build_job_id) VALUES ('bad-legacy','v','r','"+D+"','[]','{}','{}','legacy_application','rev','fabricated-job');",'23514','legacy provenance rejects fabricated build refs')
run('opl_capability',"INSERT INTO capability.capability_versions(id,version_label,artifact_repository,artifact_digest,model_requirements,data_compatibility,provenance_evidence,provenance) VALUES ('bad-build','v','r','"+D+"','[]','{}','{}','build');",'23514','build provenance requires all five source refs')
run('opl_capability',"INSERT INTO capability.reference_claims(id,target_type,capability_version_id,claimant_owner,claimant_resource_id,purpose,request_id) VALUES ('claim-1','capability_version','legacy-revision-A','workspace','old-ws','deployment','req-1');",label='claim accepts existing legacy version')
run('opl_capability',"DELETE FROM capability.capability_versions WHERE id='legacy-revision-A';",'23503','live claim blocks physical metadata DELETE via same-owner FK')
run('opl_capability',"INSERT INTO capability.reference_claims(id,target_type,capability_version_id,claimant_owner,claimant_resource_id,purpose,request_id) VALUES ('claim-2','capability_version','legacy-revision-A','workspace','old-ws','deployment','req-2');",'23505','duplicate active claim rejected')
run('opl_capability',"UPDATE capability.reference_claims SET released_at=now() WHERE id='claim-1';",'23514','claim cannot release without owner evidence')
run('opl_capability',"INSERT INTO capability.packages(id,namespace_id,name,visibility,created_by) VALUES ('x','nonexistent-ns','p','private','actor');",'23503','same-owner namespace FK rejects missing owner row')
for id in ['ws-A','ws-B']:
 run('opl_workspace',f"INSERT INTO workspace.workspaces(id,tenant_id,name,status,capability_version_id,compute_plan_id,storage_plan_id,created_by,delivery_model,version) VALUES ('{id}','opaque-tenant','test','provisioning','opaque-capability','compute-existing','storage-existing','actor','agent_saas',0);",label='cross-owner opaque IDs accepted without cross-DB FK '+id)
run('opl_workspace',"INSERT INTO workspace.operations(id,tenant_id,actor_id,kind,resource_id,stage,request_id,accepted_input) VALUES ('op-A','opaque-tenant','actor','deploy','ws-A','accepted','req-A','{}'); INSERT INTO serve.agent_deployments(id,workspace_id,capability_version_id,artifact_digest,reference_claim_id,operation_id,data_compatibility) VALUES ('dep-A','ws-A','opaque-capability','"+D+"','claim-opaque','op-A','{}'); UPDATE workspace.workspaces SET current_agent_deployment_id='dep-A' WHERE id='ws-A';",label='same-workspace selected deployment accepted')
run('opl_workspace',"UPDATE workspace.workspaces SET current_agent_deployment_id='dep-A' WHERE id='ws-B';",'23503','selected deployment cannot belong to another Workspace')
run('opl_workspace',"INSERT INTO workspace.workspaces(id,tenant_id,name,compute_plan_id,storage_plan_id,created_by,delivery_model,version,capability_version_id) VALUES ('bad-bare','tenant','bare','c','s','actor','legacy_resource_only',0,'fabricated-cap');",'23514','bare legacy resource cannot pretend to have Capability')
run('opl_workspace',"INSERT INTO workspace.workspaces(id,tenant_id,name,compute_plan_id,storage_plan_id,created_by,delivery_model,version) VALUES ('valid-bare','tenant','bare','c','s','actor','legacy_resource_only',0);",label='bare legacy resource preserves no-app state')
run('opl_tenant',"INSERT INTO tenant.tenants(id,name) VALUES ('t1','one'),('t2','two'); INSERT INTO tenant.tenant_members(id,tenant_id,actor_id,role) VALUES ('m1','t1','same-actor','owner');",label='first active Tenant membership accepted')
run('opl_tenant',"INSERT INTO tenant.tenant_members(id,tenant_id,actor_id,role) VALUES ('m2','t2','same-actor','owner');",'23505','one actor cannot have two active Tenant memberships')
run('opl_ledger',"SET ROLE opl_ledger_writer; INSERT INTO ledger.receipts(id,source_owner,source_event_id,kind,subject_type,subject_id,source_operation_id,request_id,evidence_sha256,evidence,source_occurred_at) VALUES ('receipt-opaque','workspace','event-1','test','workspace','ws-A','op-A','req-A','"+'b'*64+"','{}',now());",label='ledger writer can append receipt')
run('opl_ledger',"SET ROLE opl_ledger_writer; UPDATE ledger.receipts SET kind='changed' WHERE id='receipt-opaque';",'42501','ledger runtime writer cannot overwrite receipt')
run('opl_ledger',"SET ROLE opl_ledger_writer; DELETE FROM ledger.receipts WHERE id='receipt-opaque';",'42501','ledger runtime writer cannot delete receipt')
run('opl_ledger',"SET ROLE opl_ledger_writer; CREATE TABLE ledger.rogue(id text);",'42501','runtime writer cannot create policy/schema tables')
# Compare actual Postgres information_schema to inventory including type, nullability, constraints and indexes.
inv=json.loads((P/'contracts/db_inventory.json').read_text()); count=0
for db in inv['databases']:
 o=db['owner']; raw=run(db['name'],"SELECT table_name||'|'||column_name||'|'||udt_name||'|'||is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='"+o+"' ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position;",label='actual '+o+' field inventory')
 actual={tuple(x.split('|')[:2]):x.split('|')[2:] for x in raw.splitlines() if '|' in x}
 for t in [t for t in inv['tables'] if t['owner']==o]:
  for f in t['fields']:
   typ={'text':'text','bigint':'int8','integer':'int4','timestamptz':'timestamptz','boolean':'bool','jsonb':'jsonb','text[]':'_text'}[f['type']]
   assert actual[(t['name'],f['name'])]==[typ,'YES' if f['nullable'] else 'NO'],(o,t['name'],f['name'],actual.get((t['name'],f['name'])))
   count+=1
 print(db['name'],'inventory actual match')
res=dict(scope='temporary PostgreSQL16-alpine, --network none, tmpfs only; no current DB/volume touched',ddlDatabases=9,tableCount=len(inv['tables']),fieldCount=count,tests=results,passed=True,notProven=['Owner business transactions not implemented','end-to-end services/browser','production/instance qualification'])
pathlib.Path('/tmp/opl-db-runtime-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(res,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS',len(results),'DDL/semantic/privilege/inventory checks,',count,'actual fields matched')

import subprocess,pathlib,json,re,datetime
P=pathlib.Path('/Users/huangrende/Desktop/应聘/chatgpt-share-6ab13ad3/opl_v226_execution_spec'); C='opl-spec-db-alignment-20260922'
res=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/tmp/opl-db-runtime-verification.json').read_text()); additional=[]
def run(db,sql,expect=None,label=''):
 p=subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-i',C,'psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-v','VERBOSITY=verbose','-U','postgres','-d',db,'-At'],input=sql,capture_output=True,text=True)
 ok=(p.returncode==0) if not expect else (p.returncode!=0 and re.search(r'ERROR:\s+'+expect+r':',p.stderr) is not None)
 additional.append(dict(label=label,database=db,sql=sql,expectedSQLSTATE=expect or '00000',passed=ok))
 if not ok: raise RuntimeError(label+'\n'+p.stdout+'\n'+p.stderr)
 return p.stdout.strip()
run('opl_gateway',"INSERT INTO gateway.tenant_wallet_bindings(id,tenant_id,billing_sub2api_user_id,delegation_ref,verification_evidence_ref,bound_at) VALUES ('binding-test','tenant-test','external-subject','delegation-fixture','evidence-fixture',now());",label='opaque binding seed')
for amount in [0,-1]:
 run('opl_gateway',f"INSERT INTO gateway.wallet_operations(id,tenant_id,wallet_binding_id,kind,amount_usd_micros,business_idempotency_key,request_fingerprint) VALUES ('money-{amount}','tenant-test','binding-test','charge',{amount},'money-{amount}','request-hash');",'23514','non-positive wallet amount rejected '+str(amount))
run('opl_gateway',"INSERT INTO gateway.wallet_operations(id,tenant_id,wallet_binding_id,kind,amount_usd_micros,business_idempotency_key,request_fingerprint) VALUES ('int64-max','tenant-test','binding-test','charge',9223372036854775807,'int64-max','request-hash');",label='bigint exact int64 maximum accepted without float')
run('opl_gateway',"INSERT INTO gateway.wallet_operations(id,tenant_id,wallet_binding_id,kind,amount_usd_micros,business_idempotency_key,request_fingerprint) VALUES ('overflow','tenant-test','binding-test','charge',9223372036854775808,'overflow','request-hash');",'22003','int64 overflow rejected')
run('opl_gateway',"INSERT INTO gateway.wallet_operations(id,tenant_id,wallet_binding_id,kind,amount_usd_micros,business_idempotency_key,request_fingerprint) VALUES ('dup-money','tenant-test','binding-test','charge',1,'int64-max','request-hash');",'23505','original wallet business key cannot be duplicated')
run('opl_gateway',"INSERT INTO gateway.wallet_operations(id,tenant_id,wallet_binding_id,kind,amount_usd_micros,business_idempotency_key,request_fingerprint) VALUES ('bad-refund','tenant-test','binding-test','refund',1,'refund-key','request-hash');",'23514','refund requires original charge and entitlement')
# Catalog rows needed by same-owner quote FKs; no real provider calls.
for table,ext in [('compute_plans',",vcpus,memory_mib"),('storage_plans',",capacity_gib,shrink_supported")]:
 vals=',1,1024' if table=='compute_plans' else ',1,false'
 run('opl_resource_catalog',f"INSERT INTO resource_catalog.{table}(id,name,version_label,provider,provider_profile_ref,region,status,billing_mode,valid_from,published_by,provider_capability_version,provider_specification{ext}) VALUES ('{table}-1','plan','v1','local','isolated-profile','local','approved','LOCAL_NO_CHARGE',now(),'fixture-admin','cap-v1','{{}}'{vals});",label='local catalog fixture '+table)
run('opl_resource_catalog',"INSERT INTO resource_catalog.retention_policy_versions(id,version_label,rules,customer_terms,valid_from,published_by,workspace_data_disposition,package_history_disposition,build_history_disposition,tenant_restore_days) VALUES ('retain-1','v1','{}','fixture',now(),'fixture-admin','destroy_after_confirmed_deletion','retain','retain',15); INSERT INTO resource_catalog.refund_policy_versions(id,version_label,rules,customer_terms,valid_from,published_by,algorithm,retention_policy_version_id) VALUES ('refund-1','v1','{}','fixture',now(),'fixture-admin','workspace-delete-refund-v1','retain-1'); INSERT INTO resource_catalog.price_policy_versions(id,version_label,compute_plan_id,storage_plan_id,compute_monthly_usd_micros,storage_monthly_usd_micros,product_monthly_usd_micros,adjustment_rules,renewal_rules,valid_from,published_by,period_months) VALUES ('price-1','v1','compute_plans-1','storage_plans-1',0,0,0,'{}','{}',now(),'fixture-admin',1);",label='versioned zero-cost Local policy fixtures')
def quote(qid,amount=0,status='offered',accepted='NULL',at='NULL'):
 return f"INSERT INTO resource_catalog.quotes(id,tenant_id,actor_id,purpose,capability_version_id,compute_plan_id,storage_plan_id,price_policy_version_id,refund_policy_version_id,retention_policy_version_id,total_usd_micros,period_start,period_end,status,input_digest,admission_snapshot,accepted_by_operation_id,accepted_at,expires_at,model_selections,period_months,refund_terms,retention_terms,expected_interruption) VALUES ('{qid}','tenant-test','actor-test','create','capability-test','compute_plans-1','storage_plans-1','price-1','refund-1','retain-1',{amount},now(),now()+interval '1 month','{status}','sha256:"+'c'*64+f"','{{}}',{accepted},{at},now()+interval '1 hour','[]',1,'fixture-refund','fixture-retention','none');"
run('opl_resource_catalog',quote('quote-accepted',status='accepted',accepted="'workspace-operation-original'",at='now()'),label='accepted Quote shape binds operation and timestamp')
run('opl_resource_catalog',quote('quote-no-binding',status='accepted'),'23514','accepted Quote requires operation and acceptedAt')
run('opl_resource_catalog',quote('quote-duplicate-binding',status='accepted',accepted="'workspace-operation-original'",at='now()'),'23505','one Workspace Operation cannot accept multiple Quotes')
run('opl_resource_catalog',quote('quote-negative',amount=-1),'23514','negative Quote total rejected')
run('opl_resource_catalog',"INSERT INTO resource_catalog.quote_items(id,quote_id,kind,description,amount_usd_micros,calculation,sort_order,quantity) VALUES ('bad-line','quote-accepted','compute','fixture',-1,'{}',0,1);",'23514','negative ordinary charge line rejected')
run('opl_resource_catalog',"INSERT INTO resource_catalog.quote_items(id,quote_id,kind,description,amount_usd_micros,calculation,sort_order,quantity) VALUES ('adjustment-line','quote-accepted','adjustment','fixture',-1,'{}',0,1);",label='explicit signed adjustment allowed; sum verified by Owner transaction not SQL')
run('opl_resource_catalog',"UPDATE resource_catalog.compute_plans SET billing_mode='POSTPAID_BY_HOUR' WHERE id='compute_plans-1';",'23514','postpaid hourly resource billing prohibited')
# Cross-domain privilege denial checks do not need a network route.
for o in ['tenant','capability','build','workspace','runtime_control','fabric','gateway','resource_catalog','ledger']:
 others=[x for x in ['tenant','capability','build','workspace','runtime_control','fabric','gateway','resource_catalog','ledger'] if x!=o]
 sql="SELECT bool_and(NOT has_database_privilege('opl_"+o+"_writer',d,'CONNECT')) FROM unnest(ARRAY["+','.join("'opl_"+x+"'" for x in others)+"]) d;"
 output=run('postgres',sql,label=o+' writer cannot connect any other owner database'); assert output=='t',(o,output)
version=run('postgres','SELECT version();',label='exact PostgreSQL version readback')
image=subprocess.check_output(['docker','image','inspect','postgres:16-alpine','--format','{{json .}}'],text=True); image=json.loads(image)
actual_tables=run('opl_workspace',"SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='workspace' AND table_name='workspaces' AND column_name='current_agent_deployment_id';",label='single selected deployment authority column exists'); assert actual_tables=='1'
res['tests']+=additional; res['executedAt']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(); res['postgresVersion']=version; res['image']={'name':'postgres:16-alpine','imageId':image['Id'],'repoDigests':image.get('RepoDigests',[])}
res['commands']=['docker run --rm -d --network none --name <isolated-test-container> --tmpfs /var/lib/postgresql/data -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust postgres:16-alpine','docker exec -i <isolated-test-container> psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d <each-opl-owner-db> < split-database-block.sql','docker stop <isolated-test-container> (auto-removes only this --rm container)']
res['caveats']=['Only seeded isolated test databases were used; public/provider/Gateway network unavailable','Quote accepted immutability/body/expiry checks are Owner transaction rules, not falsely asserted as DDL CAS','Quote item sum total is Owner transaction invariant; no database trigger asserted','One selected deployment is Workspace pointer with same-workspace FK; Deployment.status is lifecycle history, not a second selection writer']
pathlib.Path('/tmp/opl-db-runtime-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(res,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('extra checks',len(additional),'total',len(res['tests']),'PASS')
